name: 05-draft-concept-not-enforceable
description: Two policy concepts and a Run scoped to the `reviewer` lane. `/loop/never-merge.md` is human-verified and stable, and carries the tag `lane/reviewer`, so it is enforceable for this Run. `/loop/agent-guess.md` was generated by a `process:` actor: its status is draft and its trust tier is `unverified`, so it must NOT be passed as enforceable however it is tagged — it carries `lane/reviewer` too, which is what makes the draft gate rather than the lane filter the reason it is excluded. Tags are `lane/<name>`, matched by the rule in §Policy scoping, which is the rule `okf.py` already implements; a bare tag `reviewer` matches no lane. Because the Run is scoped, the `stage` Event's `scope` is `reviewer`, not the empty string. An agent writing knowledge back does so only as a mailbox Message, and that message lands the concept at status draft.

concepts.body: The agent that wrote the code is never the agent that approves it.
Proposed by an agent. Not ratified.
